name: Verdict stamp
purpose: A bordered, tilted verdict label (CONFIRMED, MYTH, -18 C) with an optional second line, centred on a point of its parent and slammed on with the stamp-impact effect; the label part the cloud, Korea and fridge films each built by hand.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: accent | second | third | ink | muted | positive | negative, or a colour

inputs.name: x, y
inputs.description: Centre as fractions of the parent

inputs.name: shake
inputs.description: Element shaken on impact (e.g. the card that was hit)

implementation.api: Studio.comp.stamp(parent, {text, sub, tone, x, y, rotate}, {shake}) -> {el, enter(tl, at) -> settle time, exit(tl, at)}

layout_notes: Positioned by fractions of its parent (per-format maps through Studio.pick); border, padding and type in --u.
validation_steps: python tests/test-studio-runtime.py (hidden before the slam, settles at its tilt, shaken element returns to rest)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-24. Not rendered through HyperFrames.
